skill.summary: Transform technical insights into full 40-50 minute TED-style talks with concrete examples and Q&A

latestVersion.changelog:
- Clarified that concrete context and real examples must come from user input, not from files or assumptions.
- Revised prerequisites and section examples to emphasize grounding talks in specific, user-provided details.
- Updated Output Format and Talk Rules to specify use of real scenarios over hypothetical or file-based details.
- Adjusted language in context checklists and core logic to reflect a tighter focus on actual user context.
